facts.business: Pyxis Finvest Limited is an NBFC engaged in lending and investment/trading in securities.
key_risks: Credit and concentration risk: 71.07% of gross loan portfolio (₹970.00 lakh) exposed to a single unsecured borrower classified as sub-standard asset
Market risk: Exposure to securities price movements through investment/trading activities (quoted equity/ETF instruments ₹97.83 lakh)
Liquidity risk: Delays in loan recoveries may affect timing of future cash inflows
Recovery and litigation matters: NSEL dues and disputed income-tax matters may affect timing/amount of future recoveries or payments
Operational risks: Interconnectedness with banks amplifying systemic risks, concentration and contagion risks, over-reliance on bank credit
Technology-related risks: Cybersecurity threats and operational disruptions from digital mediums and FinTech partnerships
